title: 鉄筋コンクリート構造
subtitle: Reinforced Concrete Structure
keywords: Reinforced concrete 2.Structural analysis 3.Section design calculation 4.E-Leaning 5.Regional cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic structural design of RC structures involving cross section calculations. (2) learn the concept and procedures of structural design through a design exercise for a small-scale building in a snowy region. (3) learn construction methods and structural safety for RC structures.
advice: This is a specialty course in structural engineering. We will cover the following topics: 1. Characteristics of RC structures 2. Basics of structural design 3. Mechanical properties of materials (reinforcing bar, concrete) 4. Beam design 5. Column design 6. Shear design of RC structures and design of RC beam-column joints 7. Design of shear walls and slabs 8. Bonding, anchorage, and joints
books: Reinforced concrete structure (in Japanese) writen by Kuniaki Yamagishi Publisher: Kanazawa Institute of Technology
requiredKnowledge: The contents of the subjects “Structural mechanics I ”and “Structural mechanics II” must be understood as basic knowledge of RC structures. Since this subject has a direct connection with “Structural Design for Architecture”[Course name unified with that in #23 syllabi of this job. Please confirm here and there.] and “Architectural Integrated Exercises B”, credit for these classes is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Students understand the basics of structural design for RC structures.
Students can perform shear design for RC structures and design RC beam-column joints.

achievementLevels.ideal: Students fully understand RC structural design flow and the derivation of calculation equations, and perform preparation calculations and cross section calculations with no mistakes.
achievementLevels.standard: Students understand RC structural design flow and the meaning of the calculation equations, and can execute preparation calculation and cross section calculation with almost no mistakes.

lessons.content: Course introduction Definition and features of RC structure Basics of structural design -Flow of structural design and planning
lessons.assignments: Review basic knowledge of RC Preparation: understand the hand-out distributed in the first lecture and characteristics of your allotted building

lessons.content: Basics of structural design -Preparation calc. (load) -Preparation calc. (max. section force with simple boundary conditions and axial forces in columns)
lessons.assignments: Review loads, maximum section forces in beam with simple boundary conditions, and axial forces in columns. Preparation: understand eismic shear force and relative stiffness ratio

lessons.content: Basics of structural design -Preparation calc. (story shear force and relative stiffness ratio) -Integrated learning
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report assignment, and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: and relative stiffness ratio Preparation: review the moment distribution method learned in "Structural Mechanics II" and understand the calculation of cross section forces under lateral loading. Work on the first report.

lessons.content: Basic of structural design - Cross section forces under vertical loading - Cross section forces under lateral loading
lessons.assignments: Review: calculate cross section forces under vertical and lateral forces Preparation: read text section 2 and review the strain-stress relationship learned in "Structural Mechanics I for Architecture”
Review: understand text section 2 Preparation: read text section 3 (beam design)

lessons.content: Beam design - Stress distribution in beam sections under bending moment - Force equilibrium equations - Design formulas and design diagrams - T-beam design
lessons.assignments: Review: understand text section 2 Preparation: read text section 3 (beam design)

lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report assignment, and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: understand the assumptions, force equilibrium, and design formulas of RC beams and review the usage of design diagrams Preparation: read text section 3 (beam design)

lessons.content: Column design -Stress distribution in column sections under axial force and bending moment -Force equilibrium equations -Design formulas and design diagrams
lessons.assignments: Review: understand the assumptions, force equilibrium and design formulas of RC columns and review the usage of design diagrams Preparation: read text section 4

lessons.content: Column design -Cross section calculation methods Explanation of examples -Column design -Integrated learning
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, Report assignment and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: design RC columns referring to examples and following RC standard constraints Preparation: read text section 5 and work on report

lessons.content: Shear design of RC structure -Allowable shear force and design shear force -Design of stirrups Explanation of examples -Shear design of beams
lessons.assignments: Review: design of members under shear force and stirrups Preparation: read text section 5.3

lessons.content: Shear design of RC structures -Shear design of columns Explanation of examples -Shear design of columns -Integrated learning
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report assignment, and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: shear design of columns and hoops Preparation: work on report and study for test

lessons.content: Shear design of RC structures -Design of RC beam-column joints Explanation of examples -Design of RC beam-column joints -Integrated learning
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, report assignment, and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: design of RC beam-column joints Preparation: read text section 6 (shear walls)

lessons.content: Test and review -Design of RC beam or column Test explanation
lessons.operation: Test and review, Q&A, and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: correct mistakes on problems Preparation: read text section 5.4

lessons.content: Shear wall design Explanation of examples -Shear wall design -Integrated learning
lessons.operation: Lecture, Q&A, Report assignment and self-reflection
lessons.assignments: Review: understand shear walls and be able to design them Preparation: read text section 6 (Slab design 8)

lessons.content: Design of slabs and stairs -Slab and stair design - Bonding, anchorage, and joints Self-evaluation
